description: A warm, layered cottage living room side table vignette with a handcrafted, Scandinavian-country sensibility. A rustic side table in rough-sawn natural pine or light oak with angled trestle legs sits center frame, its surface holding three stacked hardcover books, a small woven coaster or placemat, a small ceramic mug in warm cream, and a tiny dried botanical arrangement in a small earthen vase. To the right background, a low armchair in warm natural linen or oatmeal is partially visible, with a chunky knit throw casually draped over its arm. A large lush fern in a terracotta pot sits in the background at floor level. A multi-pane window on the right side admits soft, diffuse natural light. The floor is wide-plank warm honey wood. The color palette is warm neutral — cream, natural wood, oatmeal — with small sage green accents from the plants. The mood is casual and lived-in. Camera is at seated eye level, framing a centered vignette of the side table using a normal lens.
